semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact seven-mana cast and insufficient payment; mandatory target rejects wrong player, empty, decline and invalid identity without mutation; self-destruction returns the same card with two zone-change generations and recasts with a fresh ETB.
Any-permanent targeting includes noncreature artifacts and lands; indestructible is legal but prevents destruction.

Actual sacrifice under opponent control captures that controller and returns the exact card to its owner beside a duplicate; generation and PermanentMoved Hand event agree; graveyard departure observer fires.
Intervening exile or exile then graveyard reentry invalidates the captured return even when the same physical card is back in the graveyard.
Bounce, exile and nonbattlefield-to-graveyard moves do not trigger; an invented activation rejects without mutation.
Predeparture ability removal prevents trigger capture; ability removal after capture cannot cancel the return.
A real sacrifice cost replaced by exile produces mana and no graveyard return trigger.

Token departure captures an ability but the token cannot return; a real Sculpting Steel copy survives donor departure and returns its own underlying physical card with fresh generation and reset copied values.
Actual entry with no legal target discards the mandatory trigger without parking an unusable prompt.
A target departing before resolution becomes illegal; the ability leaves both source and another incarnation untouched.
